name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Keeping a customer is the part of sales I've always been best at. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 reseller partners serving local businesses and kept all but one, mostly by staying in regular contact and stepping in early when an account started to slip. At Wix I managed a portfolio of small business accounts in Salesforce and hit 120% of my sales targets, and at Fivestars I worked a high-volume book of local businesses at up to 150 calls a day.

This role is the work I want: daily outreach to existing customers, keeping them happy, and offering the next service when it fits what they need. I document every call, meeting, and proposal in Salesforce, and I'm comfortable on the phone all day with busy small business owners.

My experience goes beyond what an associate role usually asks for, and I'm applying on purpose: I'd rather grow relationships with existing customers than chase new ones. I'm based in Colorado and available to work Eastern or Central hours. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
